description: React component for a modal dialog to add users to a team in Mattermost, including user search, selection, and display logic.

classes.name: AddUsersToTeamModal
classes.description: React component class for managing the modal to add users to a team, including search, selection, and user display functionalities.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches initial user profiles not in the team when the component mounts.

methods.name: setUsersLoadingState
methods.description: Sets the loading state for user profile fetching.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs user search based on input term, updates search results.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Calls optional callback when modal exits.

methods.name: renderOption
methods.description: Renders a user option in the multiselect dropdown.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders the selected value as username.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Adds a user to the selected list.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Removes users from the selected list.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits selected users to callback and hides modal.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal component with user search and selection UI.
